system.description:
Secret (a cup in the Halls of the Blood King). Drink from it at the Blood King's table; no study or check. You die that night and rise the next as a vampire.

You gain: undead nature (immune to poison, disease and sleep; needs no food, drink, air or sleep); Darkvision 120ft; regeneration of 5 HP at the start of your turn, except in sunlight or running water; once per round, a bite on a grappled, charmed or willing creature that deals 2d6 necrotic damage and heals you as much; Charm Gaze once per day (Will save, 10 + half your level + Charisma modifier, or charmed for 24 hours); once per day, a bat, wolf or mist form for up to an hour, keeping your HP; at 0 HP you become mist and reform in your coffin in a day, unless you fell in sunlight or running water.

You suffer: 2d6 radiant damage at the start of each turn in sunlight or running water; no entering a home uninvited; a stake through the heart destroys you while you rest in your coffin; a level of Exhaustion for each day you don't rest in your coffin and each week you don't drink a living humanoid's blood; your Allegiance becomes Evil, healing spells harm you, and you can be Turned as an undead of your Level.

  • The Blood King knows every vampire the Chalice has made.
  • The Blood King's cup, kept in his halls, which appear on the cliffs east of Lankhmar once a century.
  • Whoever drinks from it at his table rises as he did.

Monsters & Treasure, Secrets: one of a kind, never sold, placed by the GM. Study it in downtime (Study a Secret); no one can teach it.
